about: Made by .github/desktop/ai/make_scene_golden.py, whose header describes scene-v1. Maps are rows of the map; masks are rows of 0 and 1; breaks are [near x, near y, far x, far y, jump]; vertices are x, y, z one after the other, row after row; edgeCurve rows are [rho, flatten, darken]. Numbers within 1e-9.
